CACHE::headers
Description
Returns the HTTP headers of the cache response.
Syntax
CACHE
::
headers
CACHE::headers
Returns the HTTP headers of the cache response. Name / value pairs
are returned in a tcl list.
Examples
when
CACHE_RESPONSE
{
# log all  HTTP headers sent in cache response.
log
local0.
[
CACHE
::
headers
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CACHE_RESPONSE
